summary: Frontend-only verification of the Customers unread badge repositioning + click-to-messages navigation. All 7 requirements verified as passing.
verified_behaviors: Sidebar Customers row (data-testid=nav-customers) still activates customers tab on normal click.

Badge (data-testid=nav-customers-unread-badge) is absolutely positioned as overlay at top-right of the person icon. Measured icon box x=24.8,y=528.5,w=16,h=16 and badge box x=32.8,y=522.5,w=16,h=16 -> badge.x >= icon.x AND badge.y <= icon.y+icon.height (overlap in top-right quadrant).

Badge class contains bg-red-500, animate-pulse, ring-2 ring-white, rounded-full, white text. Text shows unread count ('8' at test time); '99+' cap logic present in code (n.count > 99 ? '99+' : n.count).

Clicking the badge stops propagation and navigates directly to Customers > Customer Messages. After click: data-testid=cus-messages has class 'sidebar-link active' and page header reads 'Customer messages'.
Keyboard: Focusing the badge and pressing Enter navigates to Customer Messages (verified). Pressing Space also navigates to Customer Messages (verified).
When count = 0 the badge is not rendered (guarded by n.count > 0 in layout.jsx).
Row click on Customers still activates the customers tab as expected (regression preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: Nesting an interactive element (role='button', tabIndex=0) inside a native <button> is invalid HTML (button-in-button). Works functionally in Chromium but may cause a11y warnings and inconsistent behavior in some assistive tech. Consider rendering the outer sidebar item as a div with role='button' OR the badge as a plain span with onClick + explicit event handling outside the button element.
The badge's aria-label ('N unread — open messages') is good; ensure focus outline is visible (currently no focus-visible ring classes).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing unread messages in DB (count=8) were used to render the badge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Badge overlay + click-to-messages nav works. Watch out for a11y: nested role='button' inside <button>. Regression items (stuck-orders widget, unread reply dot, timeline thumbs, days-in-status chip) were not re-tested in this iter — previous iterations 27–29 verified them and no code touched those areas.
